ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure marks the 20° and 40° meridians and approximately the 20° latitude line, showing the Indian Ocean region near southeastern Africa; on the right side, a large island southeast of Africa and its nearby sea area can be seen. Point P is near this region, and M corresponds to the area of Madagascar Island. Then reason: M can be judged to be Madagascar Island. The question asks which side of the sea area forms a fishing ground because of upwelling. Combined with knowledge of currents and seawater movement around Madagascar, the west side of Madagascar Island, that is, the side near the Mozambique Channel, has relatively obvious upwelling, with deep nutrient-rich seawater rising, which is conducive to the reproduction of plankton and thereby forms a fishing ground. Therefore the answer is the western sea area.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有20°、40°经线和约20°纬线，M位于非洲东南方的大岛位置，P在其附近，因此M应为马达加斯加岛。再结合题干问“M地哪一侧海域由于上升流而形成渔场”，调用马达加斯加周边洋流知识：马达加斯加西侧即莫桑比克海峡一侧受上升流影响较明显，营养盐上泛形成渔场。因此回答M地西部海域。

Therefore the answer is the western sea area.
